figures.caption: Fig. 1. Preliminary experiment on multimodal brain tumor classification. First ROI is segmented and 91 radiomic features are extracted. Then multimodal image/numerical branches are fused via concatenation, gated, or cross-modal attention for four-class tumor prediction.
Table 1. Per-class F1-scores and overall accuracy for unimodal (MRI only) and multimodal (image + 91 radiomic features) across three CNN backbones and three fusion strategies.
